findings.issue: T10 step 8 says to grep iframe-rendered JS for innerHTML/outerHTML/eval/new Function/document.write and classify each as 'inside iframe srcdoc — allowed' or 'in parent chrome — must remediate'. findings.issue: T10 step 2 specifies the exact CSP that should appear in the iframe srcdoc: 'default-src \'none\'; script-src \'unsafe-inline\' blob:; style-src \'unsafe-inline\'; connect-src \'none\'; img-src data: blob:; object-src \'none\'; base-uri \'none\'; frame-ancestors \'none\''. The tech-spec Acceptance Criteria line 584 specifies the same string but adds a note: '(note: \'self\' is meaningless in null-origin frame so removed)'. The existing index.html parent CSP meta (line 21) contains 'default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\' \'unsafe-inline\' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net' — this is the parent frame CSP, not the iframe srcdoc CSP. T10's grep instruction will return this parent CSP line as a false match for 'connect-src \'none\''. The task needs to clearly distinguish parent-page CSP from iframe-srcdoc CSP in its grep commands.
findings.fix: Add a note to T10 step 2 verification greps: 'The grep for connect-src none must match only within the iframe srcdoc template string, not the parent page CSP meta tag on line 21 of index.html.' Alternatively, the grep should target the string more precisely (e.g., grep within the srcdoc template JS string context).

findings.issue: T12 step 5 instructs: 'sqlite3 ~/Library/Containers/<bundle-id>/Data/Library/Application Support/MarkView/state.db .schema — confirm no insight-prefixed tables'. The state.db does NOT live in ~/Library/Containers/<bundle-id>/. The codebase uses SemanticDatabase.swift with 'init(workspaceURL: URL, dbName: String = "state.db")' which places state.db at '<workspace>/.dde/state.db' (confirmed: TestFiles/.dde/state.db exists at that path). The bundle ID container path would only be used if MarkView runs in a sandboxed container, but the project has sandbox OFF (per tech-spec Decision 7: 'Sandbox is OFF'). T12 Verification Steps give a path with '~/Library/Containers/<bundle-id>/' which will not find the database.
findings.fix: Update T12 step 5 and the Verification Steps section to use the correct path: '<workspace>/.dde/state.db'. For a test workspace, this would be e.g. '/path/to/TestFiles/.dde/state.db'. The sqlite3 command should be: sqlite3 "<workspace>/.dde/state.db" ".schema".
